games.name: [UNBANS] fight in a school
games.desc:
"fight in a school" is a ffa fighting game with the setting being a school. You can walk around and talk with friends or cause trouble and beef with other players and fight it out.

Like and favorite the game for more in game content!
Make sure to rejoin after buying a gamepass in game!

Game supports: CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE

Controls:
(PC): Left Click to attack
Hold space + WASD to weave in said direction

(CONSOLE) R2 to attack
Hold L2 + move analog stick in said direction

(MOBILE) Fist button to attack
Hold Weave button + move in said direction

More controls in game!

games.name: [将] Shogun's Reign
games.desc:
⚔️ [将] SHOGUN'S REIGN 🏯

From the fields to the throne, your destiny is yours to claim.

Welcome to [将] Shogun's Reign, a roleplaying and progression experience set in the world of Edo-period Japan, where every player begins with little more than the clothes on their back.

🌾 Work the fields. Earn your first Ryō through farming, labor, and humble trades.

🏮 Find your place. Explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates, and the dangerous roads that connect them.

⚔️ Rise through society. Build your wealth and reputation, master a profession, serve those above you, or take a more dangerous path toward power.

🏯 Climb the ranks. Become a respected warrior, influential noble, or powerful feudal lord as you compete with others for status and authority.

👑 Claim the Shogunate. At the very top stands one position above all others: Shogun. Gain enough influence, wealth, and power, and the realm itself may one day fall under your rule.
